label: latency-default
measurement: real UI actions; token fetch wall time; remote participant list (server-confirmed row, an optimistic pending row is ignored); decoded remote-track WebAudio PCM RMS plus RTP counters; rendered event cue PCM downstream of actual gain before OS output
limitations: Chromium fake microphone with bundled licensed FLEURS speech fixture; --mute-audio suppresses physical speaker output
Hidden test windows; local network only; no claim about WAN or physical audio-device latency
Non-loopback STUN/TURN endpoints filtered in the fixture; restricted-network/TURN paths are untested

phaseInstrumentation.clock: Unix milliseconds, rebased to actual DOM action
phaseInstrumentation.payloads: only event kinds, booleans, durations and ordinal IDs; no keys, SDP, JWTs or participant identities

preparationExperiment.note: Optional fixture-only preparation before first channel click, after authenticated UI ready; no capture or offer. Preparation work is reported separately, not hidden in click latency.
